missions.name: Flight School: Orientation
missions.description: Get your bearings — the camera and the target slot.

objectives.name: Change your view
objectives.description: Press [v] to cycle the camera view.

objectives.name: Aim for the Moon
objectives.description: Press [t] to cycle the target slot until TARGET reads Moon. [T] clears it.

missions.name: Flight School: Plan a Burn
missions.description: Open the planner and plant your first maneuver.

objectives.name: Open the planner
objectives.description: Press [m] to open the maneuver planner.

objectives.name: Plant a transfer to the Moon
objectives.description: With the Moon targeted, press [H] to plant a transfer you can afford.

missions.name: Flight School: Fly It
missions.description: Execute a burn and climb away from your starting orbit.

objectives.name: Climb above 700 km
objectives.description: Warp to your burn ([G]) or fire manually ([b]) and raise your altitude past 700 km.

missions.name: Flight School: Off the Pad
missions.description: Launch a Saturn V from the pad and fly it to orbit.

objectives.name: Spawn on the pad
objectives.description: Press [n], pick Saturn V, and set position to launchpad.

objectives.name: Throttle up
objectives.description: Press [z] to throttle up to 100%.

objectives.name: Stage to lift off
objectives.description: Press [space] to drop the clamps and light the engine.

objectives.name: Pitch east
objectives.description: Above 10 km, pitch east with [W] and hold it through the turn.

objectives.name: Plan the circularising burn
objectives.description: At ORBIT READY, press [C] to plant the circularising burn.

objectives.name: Fly the burn and make orbit
objectives.description: Warp to the node or fire it manually — settle into orbit.

missions.name: Flight School: Meet & Dock
missions.description: Rendezvous with a partner vessel and dock.

objectives.name: Spawn a partner in orbit
objectives.description: Press [n] to spawn a second vessel in orbit to rendezvous with.

objectives.name: Target it
objectives.description: Press [t] to cycle the target slot until TARGET shows the other vessel.

objectives.name: Plant the meeting burn
objectives.description: Press [K] to plant a burn toward it.

objectives.name: Close in and dock
objectives.description: Match up and dock the two vessels.

missions.name: Make a 1000 km Orbit
missions.description: Trim a clean, near-circular orbit at 1000 km.

objectives.name: Circular orbit at 1000 km
objectives.description: Raise and round out your orbit to 1000 km altitude (±5%, e ≤ 0.01).

missions.name: Luna Flyby
missions.description: Coast into the Moon's sphere of influence.

objectives.name: Enter Luna's SOI
objectives.description: Target the Moon, plant a transfer ([H]), and coast until the Moon's gravity takes over.

missions.name: Luna Capture
missions.description: Brake into a bound orbit around the Moon.

objectives.name: Capture at Luna
objectives.description: Burn retrograde near periapsis to drop into a bound lunar orbit (e < 1).

missions.name: Luna Landing & Return
missions.description: Land on the Moon, then bring it home.

objectives.name: Land on Luna
objectives.description: Descend and touch down anywhere on the Moon's surface.

objectives.name: Return to Earth
objectives.description: Lift off, transfer back, and settle into a bound Earth orbit (or land).

missions.name: Rendezvous & Dock
missions.description: Bring two vessels together and dock them.

objectives.name: Spawn a partner
objectives.description: Press [n] to spawn a second vessel to rendezvous with.

objectives.name: Dock the two vessels
objectives.description: Target the other vessel ([t]), close in ([K] plants a rendezvous nudge), and dock.

missions.name: Mars Flyby
missions.description: Leave Earth's neighbourhood — fly past Mars.

objectives.name: Enter Mars' SOI
objectives.description: Plant an interplanetary transfer to Mars ([t] target Mars, [H]) and coast into its sphere of influence.

missions.name: Deploy a Payload
missions.description: Carry a payload to orbit and release it on its own.

objectives.name: Deploy a payload
objectives.description: Spawn a carrier ([n] → Comsat Carrier x3 or Survey Pack), reach orbit, then press [Y] to release the top payload as its own vessel.

missions.name: Place a Comsat
missions.description: Put a relay comsat into a target orbit.

objectives.name: Circular orbit at 800 km
objectives.description: Fly your carrier into a near-circular orbit at ~800 km altitude (e ≤ 0.05).

objectives.name: Deploy on station
objectives.description: Once you're in the target orbit, press [Y] to release the comsat there.

missions.name: Relay Constellation
missions.description: Build out a relay network and bring three comsats online.

objectives.name: Deploy a relay comsat
objectives.description: Launch a Comsat Carrier ([n]), reach orbit, and press [Y] to release a relay comsat.

objectives.name: Three relays connected
objectives.description: Deploy and position relay comsats until three are connected to the network at once.
